# Alibre Py-Gear Add-On

- Py-Gear is an Alibre Design add-on that draws a parametric involute spur gear sketch on a plane you choose, so you do not have to construct the tooth profile yourself.
  - What it does
    - Adds a py-gear menu with a dialog for entering your gear parameters.
    - Lets you pick the plane in the workspace that the gear is drawn on.
    - Generates the involute tooth profile and the trochoid root fillet.
    - Leaves the result as an ordinary sketch you can extrude or edit.
  - What you need
    - Alibre Design with the AlibreScript add-on installed.
    - The .NET Framework 4.8.1 runtime on 64-bit Windows.
    - Visual Studio or MSBuild if you want to build it yourself.
  - Getting started
    - Clone the repository and run `git submodule update --init --recursive`, because the gear maths lives in a submodule.
    - Build the solution in `source/` in Release configuration.
    - Copy the build output into your Alibre Design add-ons directory.
    - Start Alibre Design, open a part, and choose the py-gear menu.
  - Where things live
    - `source/` holds the VB.NET add-on, the gear script, and the manifest.
    - `submodules/` holds the py-gear geometry source and the Alibre Script ADK.
    - `documentation/` holds reference notes.
    - `reviews/` holds dated code reviews.
  - Good to know
    - The gear script runs under IronPython 2.7, so keep it compatible with Python 2.7.
  - Use it under the MIT License.
